repos_data.description: Voice-to-text dictation app with local (Nvidia Parakeet/Whisper) and cloud models (BYOK). Privacy-first and available cross-platform.
Your personal voice interface for any app. Speak naturally and your words appear wherever your cursor is, with fully customizable AI voice dictation.  Open source alternative to Wispr Flow.

🎙️ An intelligent voice productivity assistant that turns speech into clean text, useful actions, and structured knowledge. It helps users capture ideas, communicate naturally, automate repetitive tasks, and stay productive across different apps and workflows.
Tiny android dictation app that turns speech into clear writing.

Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.
The best open-source alternative to Superwhisper & Wispr Flow. Voice-to-text app for macOS with no subscription
Hold Fn key, speak, paste transcribed text. macOS menu bar app.
hns is a speech-to-text CLI tool to transcribe your voice from your microphone directly to clipboard. Integrate hns with Claude Code, Ollama, LLM, and more CLI tools for powerful workflows.

Dockerized OpenAI-compatible wrapper for Kokoro-82M text-to-speech w/multiplatform CPU, AMD, NVIDIA GPU PyTorch; multi-speaker, voice-mixing, auto-stitching, caption timestamps, SSML, readalong web UI

Cut AI context cost without trusting the compressor. Every reduction is reversible, byte-exact recoverable, and carries an auditable receipt. Local-first, works through proxy, MCP, SDK, or agent wrapper.
Local speech-to-text for macOS  on-device AI, fully private, optional cloud
